Favorites are saved in Still on this phone. Your original files and system favorites stay as they are.
Choose the photos and videos Still can show. Viewing them needs no account or cloud connection.
Still shows only the photos and videos Android allows. You can change access anytime.
Android controls which items are available. Reduced access does not mean a photo was deleted.
No photos or videos to show
No accessible photos or videos yet. Add some on your phone or change Still’s photo access.
Try another filename or media filter. Search covers the media Android lets Still read.
Choose All to include both photos and videos in this view.
Library details couldn’t be saved. You can still browse the available photos and videos.
Updating library details on this phone…
Still stores library details on this phone. Your photos and videos stay where they are. Current Android photo access decides what Still can show.
Open a photo or video and choose Add to Still favorites to find it here.
Some saved favorites aren’t available right now. They’re still saved.
Refresh your library to try again.
Your library could not be read. Check photo access and retry.
This item is unavailable. Photo access may have changed.
This video could not be played. Its format or photo access may be unavailable.
This development build opens your phone library. Matching-copy review is available in Cleanup. Deletion, backup and creative tools are still being built.
This build has no internet permission. It reads permitted media in place and does not upload your photos or library metadata.

When you start, Still reads static JPEG and PNG photos Android currently allows. Android may fetch cloud-backed media, convert photos or remove metadata before Still reads them. Each photo read is limited to 16 MiB, and each run to 256 MiB, across up to 50,000 library items. Larger photos are skipped; a run may leave other photos for later. Still saves compact appearance descriptors in a private index on this phone, not photo files. Videos, motion photos, animated images and other formats are skipped.
Clearing removes Still’s saved appearance descriptors. It does not change photos or videos.
This removes the local similarity index from Still. Your original photos and videos are not changed. You can build the index again later.
Indexing is optional. Start when you want to search selected photos across your current library.
Stopping. A photo read may need to finish first.
Indexing stopped. You can continue later.
Some photos were left out. You can continue any that remain or start another update later.

Saved descriptors: %1$d · Photos in current library: %2$d
Still could not open the local index. Existing saved data is retained.
The library changed during indexing. Refresh the library before trying again.
This index supports up to 50,000 accessible media items.
A previous media read is still finishing. Still has not queued another scan.
The media read lane stays reserved until Still can confirm the previous read has closed.
Use your phone’s screen lock or available biometrics to open Still.
Use your phone’s screen lock or an available biometric.
Require device authentication when opening Still or returning to it.
When app lock is on, leaving Still, including sharing or changing phone settings, locks it again.
Still allows screenshots and screen recordings.
App lock protects access through Still. Other apps can still open photos in your phone library.
Set a device screen lock in Android Settings before turning on app lock.
Your phone’s screen lock is unavailable. Set one up in Android security settings.
Authentication was canceled. App lock settings did not change.
Device authentication is unavailable. Try your phone’s screen lock or open Android security settings.
Authentication did not finish. Try again.
App lock could not be turned on because its setting was not saved. This session stays locked. Retry to save it.
The lock setting could not be saved. Still remains locked. Authenticate, then retry the change.
The lock setting needs recovery. Protection stays on until you authenticate and save a new setting.

Compare the photo and video data Android lets Still read. Android may fetch cloud-backed media, remove metadata or convert media before it is read. A match does not prove the underlying originals are identical. Nothing is deleted.
This scan covers only the media currently available through your limited Android access.
The gallery is still loading or could not be read. Wait for it to finish, or refresh before starting a scan.
Allow photo and video access before starting a scan.
Stopping… A provider read may need to finish before the scan stops.
Scan stopped. Start a new scan when you are ready.
This scan is no longer current. Refresh, access changes or leaving Still can end a scan. Start a new scan to compare again.
A previous provider read is still finishing. Try starting again after it stops. No scan has been queued.
The scan could not finish. No matching-copy results were kept.
This scan supports up to 50,000 accessible items. The scan stopped without matching-copy results.
Finding the currently accessible photos and videos…
No items could be compared. See the coverage counts and start a new scan after access or media changes.
No matching copies found among the items compared. Items omitted by the prefilter, changed or unreadable items were not compared.
Favorite status unavailable. Extra-copy choices for this group are paused.
Matching readable content is protected in Still
Protection choices are current. They are Still cleanup preferences; they do not lock files or stop other apps changing or deleting them.
Protection status unavailable. Extra-copy choices are paused. Existing saved records are retained.
The protection change could not be confirmed. Extra-copy choices are paused.

Save protection for this readable content in Still. This applies to ALL copies with matching readable data, including later copies only after they are freshly scanned. Changed or converted data may no longer match. It does not lock files or change other apps.
Remove the Still protection choice for ALL copies with this matching readable data, including later freshly scanned matches. Manual keepers and Still favorites remain separate. Nothing is deleted.
Choose at least one keeper before marking other copies for review. You can keep multiple copies. Keeper choices last only for this scan.

Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD.
Uses temporary copies of these two photos, up to 32 MiB each (64 MiB total). Android may remove metadata, convert photos or fetch cloud-backed media.
A photo read may need to finish before temporary copies can be removed.
Still couldn’t clear temporary comparison storage. New comparisons are unavailable until cleanup succeeds.
Another media read or comparison is still active. Try again after it finishes.

Comparison is unavailable when more than 50,000 library items are accessible. No temporary photo copies were prepared.
The library or photo access changed. Refresh and select the photos again.
Select two available photos in this view to compare.
Still couldn’t prepare these photos. Close and try again.
Still can’t preview these photos for comparison.
Select 2–200 photos. Supports static JPEG and PNG; up to 16 MiB per photo and 256 MiB per search.

Checks selected photos against the current on-device index when available, across dates. New indexing is optional and starts in Settings. This search reads selected static JPEG and PNG photos only. Limit: 16 MiB per photo and 256 MiB per search. Android may convert photos, remove metadata or fetch cloud-backed media.
Similar-looking photos can contain different text, expressions or changes. Compare to check the details.
